Power and value estimate

None of these cards exist in print, so their real market price is nothing. The estimate asks what each would sell for if printed as a Commander legend: playable power first, then rarity, color count, and how slow it is.

Set total: $193. Vespera, Last Dreamer and Thalgrin are the chase cards: each draws, recurs or kills for very little mana. Multicolor and seven-mana cards price low, since few decks can cast them on time. Rules flaws also pull a price down: Veylan transforms without a back face, and The Bloodbound Abyss uses an “if” where it needs a “when”.

The verdict, in cipher

The written analysis, set in glyphs. Each letter flips to its partner and back, so the text shifts as you read. Reveal the plain text any time.
